en.name: Precision Fuel PF 30 Gel (Box of 15)
en.title: Precision Fuel PF 30 Gel: True Cost per 30 g Carbs, Zero-Sodium Modular Math
en.summary: Clean 51 g gel packing an exact 30 g modular dose of 2:1 glucose-to-fructose carbs at $2.33 per 30 g—among the best values in Informed Sport certified endurance gels.
en.best_for: Endurance athletes who want effortless 30/60/90 g/hr carb math, mild neutral flavor, and decoupled sodium management
local_gotchas: Contains intentionally 0 mg sodium so you can tune sweat-sodium separately with PH 1000 or PH 1500—do not forget electrolytes in heat.
Uses a 2:1 glucose-to-fructose ratio (12 g sugar, 18 g maltodextrin); well tolerated up to 90 g/hr, though 1:0.8 ratios can feel smoother above 100 g/hr.
Mild neutral citrus flavor minimizes palate fatigue across 4–6 hour rides and Ironman bike legs.
